headline: Multiplayer shares equipment and planets, with smoother remote movement
summary: Co-op players now share owned weapons, gadgets, packs, gold bolts and unlocked planets. Bolts come from the host's world and fly to the player who takes them, including in other players' views. Remote figures, held items and world objects gain smoother movement over slow links, and standing figures no longer bob.
highlights: Multiplayer v0.7.1 and v0.7.3 were released. The public OpenRAC server becomes the default, with a local server still selectable.
Android native builds arrive through SDK 1.10.1. Releases include difficulty v1.2.3, item-randomizer v1.0.3, lock-strafe v1.0.2 and live-splits v1.0.2.
Other Android releases are keyboard-mouse v1.2.4, ammo-max v1.0.2, multiplayer v0.7.3, xbox-icons v1.0.1 and dualsense v1.0.2. The platform-build patch bumps leave mod code unchanged.
Earlier releases also include difficulty v1.2.2, button-swap v1.0.0 and xbox-icons v1.0.0. Developers gain delayed-message testing and more detailed remote-pose logs.
